judgment: It is good to have somewhere to go.
It is good to ford the great river.
image: So the noble one, seeing good, moves towards it;
lines: It is good to use this for great work.
Great good. No harm.
Someone adds to it —
a tortoise worth ten strings of cowries — cannot be refused.
Holding firm, long: good.
The king offers to the god on high: good.
Added to by a time of misfortune: no harm.
There is trust, walking the middle;
tell the duke, jade tablet in hand.
Walking the middle:
tell the duke — he follows.
It is good to use this support
to move the state.
There is trust, a kindly heart:
do not ask — great good.
There is trust: kindness answers my virtue.
No one adds to it;
someone strikes it.
A heart set up without constancy.
Misfortune.

notes.name_en: 益 is overflow, adding to; 'Adding', paired with 41 Lessening.
notes.L3: 用凶事: gain that comes through another's ill time (relief work, funerals) — 'by a time of misfortune'.
